overview.about: The Cadillac Championship is played at the Blue Monster at Trump National Doral in Miami, one of the most storied resort courses in American golf and for years the home of a World Golf Championship. Its water-lined layout and famous closing 18th make it a demanding, dramatic test.
overview.nextEvent: The next Cadillac Championship is played on the Blue Monster course at Trump National Doral. The long, water-guarded layout and the intimidating final hole reward power and nerve in equal measure.
